title: Izmis Lake
subtitle: Above Utror, Upper Swat
edits: Lake bed lowered under the measured water level; the depth shown is illustrative (no published bathymetry).
A bench up to 24 m wide is cut along the jeep track to its smoothed profile (the 30 m DSM includes tree canopy).
Road bumps and ruts in the drive are illustrative; the grade and the line of the jeep track are real.
Trees, shrubs, grass tufts and boulders are placed where WorldCover maps that cover; their size and number are illustrative.
The shore path is traced 20 m outside the lake outline; it is not a mapped trail.
The walk from the end of the jeep track follows the mapped OSM footpath for 0.0 km; the last 5.91 km is not mapped and is traced over the ground (easiest slope on the DEM).
Season colours, snow, ice and dawn mist are illustrative.

Traffic on the drive is illustrative: the vehicle kinds are those seen on Swat roads (Willys jeeps, Hilux, Suzuki vans, Mehran cars, CD70 motorbikes, Qingqi rickshaws, painted trucks); their number and movement are not counted.
